source.author: verg
source.text: Saevit atrox Volcens nec teli conspicit usquam auctorem nec quo se ardens immittere possit.
source.text_original: Saevit atrox Volcens nec teli conspicit usquam / auctorem nec quo se ardens immittere possit.
source.text_english: Fierce Volcens rages, and sees nowhere the author of the weapon, nor where, in his fury, he can hurl himself.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Saevit atrox Pelias inimicaque vertice ab alto vela videt nee qua se ardens effundere possit.
reuse.text_original: Saevit atrox Pelias inimicaque vertice ab alto / vela videt nee qua se ardens effundere possit.
reuse.text_english: Pelias rages fiercely and, hostile, sees the sails from the high summit, nor can he see by what route the blazing vessel may pour itself out.
